title: Move a glass reaction tube from a 95 C dry bath to a cooling rack with a self-closing wooden test-tube holder
instruction: Move the glass test tube from the dry bath into the stainless cooling rack with the wooden test-tube holder, without touching the tube or the heating block with the grippers, then lay the holder back on the blue mat.
context: Analytical and inorganic chemistry labs (qualitative cation analysis, acid hydrolysis, colorimetric reducing-sugar assays) heat 16 x 100 mm borosilicate test tubes in dry-block heaters (Four E's TC0401001 manual: 'For heating media in block heaters... Laboratories, Schools, Pharmacies and universities') under standard safety rules (Malik, Qualitative Analysis of Common Cations in Water, 2.2: 'Hold the hot test tube with a test tube holder... Never hold the hot test tube with a bare hand'). Unlike culinary tongs that close when squeezed, a wooden clothespin holder clamps under its spring when released and opens only while squeezed against that spring: one hand carries and plumbs the 260.4 mm handle while the other squeezes the short lever 120 mm ahead, fits the V-jaws round the 16.0 mm glass neck clear of the block, releases to clamp, lifts plumb from the 45.0 mm well, threads a two-tier 17 mm rack hole, squeezes open, and returns the holder.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (left y = +30.5, right y = -30.5), x forward, y left, z up from the bench; fixed layout (jitter 0). At (45.8, +11.5) sits a FOUR E'S SCIENTIFIC TC0401001 single-block digital dry bath (19.0 x 15.2 x 8.6 cm, 1.50 kg, white polymer case) fitted with its 16 mm aluminium block TC0401001-84 (7.6 x 9.6 cm centred at (45.3, +11.5), 4.5 cm deep wells). For safe shared-rig evaluation the real unit is run switched off at room temperature (dark LED; or powered on in idle standby without pressing Run/Stop, showing ambient ~22.0 C while the simulation draws the 95.0 set-point steadily on the bezel); because the real block and dry empty tube are unheated, the bare-gripper contact zeros on the tube and block act as explicit evaluation rules. In the front-middle well at (42.8, +11.5, floor z = 4.1 cm) stands an empty DWK PYREX 1620/09M borosilicate rimmed test tube (ISO 4142, 1.60 cm OD x 10.0 cm long, 1.84 cm rolled rim, 5.5 cm exposed). At (43.5, -6.5) sits a BOCHEM 8291 (BrandTech B8291) stainless Z-shape cooling rack (22.0 x 11.0 x 5.0 cm, 10 x 5 holes for 17 mm tubes across z = 2.4 and 5.0 cm tiers over a 0.2 cm solid floor), square within 2 degrees on pencil ticks (+-2 mm). At (27.5, -23.0) lies a blue TRU COMPONENTS TC-14962248 silicone mat (30.0 x 20.0 x 0.2 cm), carrying a closed Eisco Labs CH0726B wooden test-tube holder (26.04 cm long, jaws up to 3.18 cm, 45.4 g) flat on its 1.6 cm side with its hinge pin at (34.0, -20.5) (+-2 mm), jaws pointing +x (+-2 deg).
scoring: 0 for good if at any step either gripper touches the glass tube or the 96 x 76 mm aluminium heating block, the tube touches the bench or mat or tilts past 35 degrees, or the dry bath or rack slides past 20 mm or tilts past 10 degrees (on the bench, judged from the trial video, the end photo confirming the final state). Otherwise read at the end. 1.0: the tube stands upright (8 degrees tilt at most) through both guide tiers of any hole of the stainless cooling rack with its underside within 6 mm of the 2 mm rack floor; the wooden holder lies flat on either side (12 degrees tilt at most, bar centre within 26 mm of the bench) inside the 300 x 200 mm blue mat (within 5 mm of its edge) and at least 20 mm clear of the tube, dry bath and rack; every part of both hands stands at least 30 mm from all objects, held for 1.0 s (20 steps) while the tube and holder move 3 mm at most. 0.5: the tube stands upright in a rack hole as above, the other 1.0 conditions not all met. 0.25: the wooden holder's jaws hold the tube by its barrel clear of the dry bath (underside at least 90 mm over the bench, tilted 15 degrees at most). 0 otherwise. Bench tools: trial video, steel rule, phone inclinometer.
reset_notes: Between trials, about 45 seconds: lift the dry PYREX 1620/09M tube from the stainless rack and stand it upright in the front-middle well (42.8, +11.5 cm) of the unheated dry bath block; check the dry bath and BOCHEM 8291 rack sit on their pencil corner ticks within 2 mm and 2 degrees; lay the closed Eisco CH0726B wooden holder flat on its side on the blue mat with its hinge pin on the tick at (34.0, -20.5 cm) within 2 mm and jaws pointing +x within 2 degrees. Dry glassware only; nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid bodies in PhysX (contact offset 0.3 mm) at 1:1 size and mass. Faceted 16.0 mm tube uses chamfered 18.6 mm bath and 18.4 mm rack bores (2.6 and 2.4 mm play vs 0.4 and 1.0 mm real play). Holder hinge jaw_h has a preloaded torsion spring (2.20 N m/rad, rest -13.8 deg); anti-creep weld w_grip between tube and long_arm engages where the tube stands after >=10 deg opening and bilateral >=6 N jaw load, cutting at >=11.5 deg opening or >18 N jam. Heat is not simulated.
